entities.summary: Aleksey Aleksandrovich Obmochaev is a Russian volleyball player, a member of Russia men's national volleyball team and Russian club Kuzbass Kemerovo. He was a champion at the 2011 World Cup, and a gold medalist at the 2012 Olympics.
